string.text: High capacity magazine (brown, 45 rounds)
Allows you to reduce the number of reloads in battle, increasing your chances of staying alive.
High capacity magazine (black, 45 rounds)
Allows you to reduce the number of reloads in battle, increasing your chances of staying alive.
High capacity magazine (60 rounds)
Allows you to send even more opponents to the best of two worlds with one burst.
Butt pad
Allows you to soften the recoil from a weapon shot.
Bayonet

Installing a standard 6x5 bayonet on a weapon allows you to use the machine gun as a melee weapon.Due to the design features of the weapon, it is impossible to use a bayonet simultaneously with an under-barrel grenade launcher or silencer.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Replacing the gas outlet lining
The presence of Weaver-type rails on the new lining allows you to install additional types of sights, a flashlight and a laser pointer on the weapon.
Laser pointer

Visually indicates the location of the intended hit on the target, greatly facilitating and speeding up aiming, as well as having a demoralizing effect on the victim.Does not interfere with the installation of a tactical flashlight and can be used in conjunction with it.
Tactical flashlight

A narrowly focused, long-range flashlight is indispensable in night forays, as well as when exploring and clearing dark rooms.Does not interfere with the installation of a laser pointer and can be used in conjunction with it.
Anatomical handle
Provides the right hand with a more comfortable grip.
Replacing the handguard
Installing an improved forend makes it easier to grip the weapon with your left hand.
Barrel adjustment
Increases the initial speed of a bullet, which has a beneficial effect on the accuracy of firing.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Forcing USM
Refinement of trigger units makes it possible to increase the rate of fire of weapons, unfortunately, at the cost of some reduction in reliability.
Rate of fire retarder

Allows you to make shooting more stable by reducing the spread of bullets, and contributes to more economical consumption of ammunition.It also reduces the heating of the barrel, which has a beneficial effect on the life of the weapon.
Light alloy parts
Replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts allows you to reduce the weight of the weapon.
Heavy Duty Parts
Replacing weapon parts with their counterparts made of more durable alloys can significantly increase the reliability of weapons.
Lightweight stock
Reduces the weight of weapons, allowing you to carry more ammunition or an additional artifact during a sortie.
